Bettina, I couldn't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler refused the request with a gateway credentials error, so nothing is scheduled and I haven't posted anything.

What I checked so you know the digest will work once it's scheduled:

- #coastal-team and #coastal-random have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so combining them doesn't expose anything new to anyone.
- The digest will leave out money terms such as discounts, rates, prices, contract values and invoice amounts, since those go only to finance and the account owner. Operational items like ticket numbers, door issues and account names will stay in.
- It will not include anything from direct messages.

The first run would be Monday 19 October at 08:00 Chicago time, with the digest covering the previous 7 days.

To get this running, someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler's credentials. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll create the job. I also couldn't check for an existing digest job, so it's worth confirming there isn't already one.
